baseline_models.mechanism: The imperative asks the Lord to cause a boundary crossing into a cultivated, enclosing interior. The relative clause makes that crossing the execution of a prior commitment rather than access won at the threshold.

activation_trace.role: Sovereign lordship supplies the agent who can authorize and effect the requested transfer.
Literal ingress supplies the boundary crossing that the causative imperative asks God to perform.
The tree-screened garden supplies both the literal destination and its character as an enclosing cultivated interior.
A spoken commitment that opens expectation makes admission the fulfillment of an obligation God has assumed.

changed_reading.before: A request that the believers be placed in the paradise previously promised to them.
changed_reading.after: A request for God to enact a promised transfer across a boundary into a sheltered, cultivated interior whose accessibility rests on His own commitment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ومن صلح من آبائهم وأزواجهم وذرياتهم
baseline_models.mechanism: The clause extends admission in three relational directions, upward to fathers, laterally to spouses, and downward to descendants, but gates every direction with صلاح. The result is not automatic blood solidarity; it is the selective repair and reassembly of a dispersed kin network.

activation_trace.role: Nurturing, repairing, and bringing to completion supplies the Lord's functional role in reconstituting the household.
صلاح as the opposite of فساد makes moral soundness, rather than kinship alone, the admission gate.
Reconciliation after estrangement supplies the social mechanism by which separated relations can be gathered without erasing the condition.
Fatherhood and nurture mark the upward generational relation included in the repaired group.
A counterpart joined to its mate supplies the lateral bond restored to co-presence.
Small particles spreading outward image the descendants as a dispersed downward extension gathered back into relation.

changed_reading.before: The principal beneficiaries may have righteous relatives added to their reward.
changed_reading.after: Admission selectively reconstitutes a whole relational field across generations and spouses, with صلاح repairing and delimiting the household at once.

baseline_models.mechanism: The closing names the capacity to overcome every barrier and, immediately beside it, the restraint, judgment, and exact construction that direct that capacity. It therefore functions as both guarantee and control on the requested admission.

activation_trace.role: Prevailing force supplies the capacity to overcome death, separation, and every barrier to admission.
Restraint that prevents فساد makes power protective and discriminating rather than indiscriminate.
Exact, perfected construction supplies the ordering by which persons and relations are placed in their fitting destination.

changed_reading.before: The verse closes with a conventional affirmation that God is powerful and wise.
changed_reading.after: The names assert that admission is executable by prevailing power while wisdom constrains, selects, and perfectly orders that execution.

baseline_models.mechanism: The packet's split mapping lets the promise cue carry not only a speech commitment but also preparation of an عدة and a fixed, recurring appointment. On that branch, the destination is heard as provisioned and scheduled before the petitioners arrive.

activation_trace.role: A promise fixed to a time or place supplies the ordinary appointment structure.
Preparation of equipment or stored provision turns the promised destination into something made ready in advance.
A counted, recurring time adds temporal appointment to the destination's prior preparation.

changed_reading.before: The gardens are guaranteed by an earlier divine statement.
changed_reading.after: The gardens are also imaginatively carried as a prepared appointment, ready and temporally fixed before their occupants cross into them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, might is paired with knowledge and forgiveness, while حكم and قضاء repeatedly separate persons in truth. This turns the focus closure into an operational claim: the power that can reunite a household is exercised through just, effective classification.

activation_trace.role: Prevailing power anchors the focus claim that no obstacle can frustrate admission.
Judgment between people anchors the discriminating side of the focus closure.
The opening pairing of might with knowledge frames power as informed rather than bare force.
Covering sin while protecting its bearer supplies the restorative use of divine capacity requested in the prayer.
The explicit assignment of judgment to God makes the focus name a governing function.
A cutting, decisive judgment supplies the act that turns moral distinction into destination.
Truth fixed against falsehood supplies the norm governing the decisive act.
Judgment already rendered between servants shows حكمة producing differentiated outcomes.
Perfect execution of a decided matter supplies the efficacy joining wisdom to might.

structural_cues: 40:2 pairs العزيز with العليم; 40:3 immediately spans forgiveness and severe penalty.
40:12, 40:20, 40:48, and 40:68 repeatedly move from divine judgment to an effective, differentiated result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated pairings of power, knowledge, forgiveness, truth, and effective judgment; I infer that the focus names guarantee a just execution of the petition. A live alternative is that العزيز الحكيم remains a general praise formula whose local mechanics should not be pressed.

changed_reading.before: The final names generally reassure the petitioner that God can grant the request.
changed_reading.after: The final names claim that God can execute the promised family admission and that His execution is truth-governed, discriminating, and effective rather than indiscriminate.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent prayer surrounds garden admission with covering of sin and two requests for protection. Admission is therefore the constructive middle of a salvation sequence: damage is covered, destructive exposure is blocked, a sheltered destination with repaired relations is positively built, and residual evils are kept outside.

activation_trace.role: Ingress anchors the positive transition at the center of the surrounding petitions.
A protecting shield activates the gardens as positive enclosure, not scenery alone.
Covering sin and shielding its bearer supplies the sequence's first restorative operation.
Deflecting harm supplies the negative boundary immediately before the requested garden ingress.
Merciful tenderness supplies the encompassing motive within which the sequence operates.
Repeated protection resumes the boundary operation after admission and kin reunion.
Whatever causes hurt supplies the material that must remain outside the protected interior.
Rescue joined to attaining good names the whole multi-stage movement as success.

structural_cues: 40:7 ends with protection from the punishment of hell, 40:8 asks admission and kin reunion, and 40:9 resumes protection from evils.
The object pronouns continue across the three ayat, so the focus request belongs to one sustained intercession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a continuous prayer and branches of covering, harm-deflection, shielding, and rescue; I infer that admission is its constructive middle rather than one parallel benefit. The live alternative is a simple list of independent requests without a staged causal order.

changed_reading.before: Admission to the gardens is a standalone positive reward.
changed_reading.after: Admission is the positive enclosure at the center of a complete rescue process, converting forgiveness and protection into a sheltered life with repaired relations.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later uses of دخول repeatedly assign people to hell, while its occupants ask whether any path of خروج remains and the final command adds gates, abiding, and a settled lodging. Against that network, the focus imperative is the opposite terminal routing, not a temporary visit.

activation_trace.role: The focus ingress anchors the positive side of the surah's two-way destination routing.
The screened garden supplies the positive interior opposed to the fire's interior.
A sought passage to the outside supplies the failed reverse movement that makes destination entry terminal.
The command to cause Pharaoh's house to enter punishment supplies the punitive mirror of the focus imperative.
The arrogant entering hell confirms that دخول functions as adjudicated placement.
The final entry command supplies a second direct counter-command to the garden petition.
A door as the defined ingress point makes the boundary and its crossing explicit.
Persistence not quickly touched by ending supplies the irreversible duration of the assigned interior.
A lodging or settled abode makes entry a placement into a lasting home.

structural_cues: 40:11 asks whether there is any path out; 40:46, 40:60, and 40:76 answer with repeated entry into the contrary destination.
40:76 joins entry to gates, abiding, and a lodging, turning motion across a threshold into final placement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed entry scenes, a failed request for exit, and markers of permanence; I infer a binary terminal-routing mechanism. The live alternative is that the repeated دخول is rhetorical contrast without implying equal structural permanence for every detail of the two destinations.

changed_reading.before: The prayer asks for access to paradise.
changed_reading.after: The prayer asks for the beneficiaries' final routing into the good interior, opposite an irrevocable ingress whose occupants cannot find a path back out.

context_deltas.mechanism: The believing man belongs to آل فرعون yet is individually protected, while evil encloses that آل and the same house is ordered into punishment. This sequence activates من صلح as a boundary-redrawing operator: inherited or political household membership can be severed, and a righteous household can be reassembled across former affiliations.

activation_trace.role: Moral soundness anchors the focus criterion that redraws kin inclusion.
Ancestral relation anchors the vertical household whose membership is being qualified.
Paired relation anchors the lateral household whose membership is being qualified.
Dispersed descendants anchor the downward household whose membership is being qualified.
A man's آل as those who return to him and to whom he returns supplies a corporate affiliation that can conflict with personal faith.
Concealment of faith marks the believing member as internally distinct from his surrounding house.
Protection that deflects harm supplies the individual's separate routing from the corporate group.
Evil descending and enclosing its target supplies the contrary corporate routing.
The repeated آل identifies the affiliated group on which the contrary outcome closes.
Caused ingress converts corporate affiliation into a destination assignment.
Pharaoh's آل is the corporate object of entry, sharpening the contrast with the selectively righteous family in the focus.

structural_cues: 40:28 locates a believing man inside Pharaoh's آل; 40:45 protects him while evil encloses that آل; 40:46 assigns the آل to punishment.
The focus does not say all kin but inserts من صلح before fathers, spouses, and descendants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a concealed believer within Pharaoh's house followed by singular protection and corporate punishment; I infer that this sequence models moral redrawing of household boundaries. A live alternative is that آل فرعون denotes a regime or court rather than the domestic kin types listed in the focus, so the analogy is structural rather than identical.

changed_reading.before: Righteous members of an existing biological family are allowed to accompany one another.
changed_reading.after: صلاح redraws household destiny: a person can be released from a corrupt corporate house, and morally sound relations can be reassembled into a new destination-spanning household.

context_deltas.mechanism: The afterlife is called the house of settlement, while created habitation elsewhere combines settled ground, overhead construction, rest, and provision. These cues activate the gardens as a fully made habitat into which repaired relations are re-housed, not merely a landscape displayed as reward.

activation_trace.role: Nurture, repair, and completion anchor the habitat-maker who brings both persons and their setting to fitness.
The tree-screened garden anchors the cultivated habitat receiving the reassembled household.
A resident identified with a dwelling supplies the afterlife's character as inhabited home.
Fixity and settlement supply permanence to that inhabited home.
Dwelling and settling in a place supply repose as a designed function of habitation.
The earth made stable supplies the ground layer of a deliberately habitable environment.
Construction by joining parts supplies the overhead architectural layer of that environment.
Sustaining food supplies ongoing maintenance within the built habitat.

structural_cues: 40:39 contrasts temporary worldly enjoyment with the afterlife as دار القرار.
40:61 and 40:64 assemble rest, stable ground, a built sky, good form, and provision under the same divine lordship named in the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a stable afterlife home and a local template of designed habitation; I infer that the promised gardens re-house a repaired kin ecology in an enduring provisioned setting. The live alternative is that the creation template illustrates present beneficence and should not be projected architecturally onto the gardens.

changed_reading.before: The family is reunited inside a beautiful reward landscape.
changed_reading.after: The Lord re-houses a repaired family network within an enduring, cultivated, restful, and provisioned habitat.

context_deltas.mechanism: 40:40 expands the focus's صالح into a person who intentionally does صالح while believing, whether male or female, and then uses the same entry and garden roots. Kin reunion is therefore an aggregation of qualified persons rather than passive transfer by association, while their shared life exceeds ordinary accounting.

activation_trace.role: Moral soundness anchors the condition placed over the focus's family list.
Intentional action turns صالح from inherited family status into enacted qualification.
The repeated صلاح directly resolves the focus condition through morally sound action.
The same ingress root makes these qualified actors the persons crossing the garden boundary.
The same garden branch identifies the destination with the focus's promised gardens.
An allotted gift supplies positive life after entry rather than entry as bare acquittal.
Counting and reckoning supply the measure explicitly surpassed by provision within the garden.

structural_cues: 40:40 repeats صالح, دخول, and جنة from the focus in one sentence.
The verse specifies male or female and belief before entry, then provision without حساب.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies near-verbatim root repetition and explicit individual predicates; I infer that each reunited relative is a qualified entrant rather than a merely carried dependent. A live alternative is that the focus may still allow an additional family uplift beyond the minimum rule stated in 40:40.

changed_reading.before: Righteous relatives may enter through their association with the principal beneficiaries.
changed_reading.after: Each relative is heard as a believing doer of صالح who enters in his or her own qualified capacity, and the focus asks that those entrants be reunited beyond a merely calculated payout.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact refrain that God's promise is true is twice joined to patience, and the latter occurrence allows only partial visibility before death and return. Combined with the packet's preparation and appointment branch, the focus promise becomes objectively ready and binding before its realization is visible to its recipients.

activation_trace.role: The divine commitment anchors the focus destination in a promise rather than present sight.
Preparation of provision supplies the exploratory claim that readiness can precede manifestation.
Holding oneself against impatience supplies the recipient's posture during deferred realization.
A promise fixed to an appointment supplies a future realization not invalidated by delay.
Truth fixed against falsehood supplies objective validity before the event is seen.
The repeated restraint confirms that temporal delay is part of the promise's reception.
Counted and recurring time supplies an exploratory temporal structure for a promise only partly shown before return.
The repeated assertion of truth keeps fulfillment independent of immediate visibility.
Return to the originating authority supplies the far boundary across which deferred fulfillment remains binding.

structural_cues: 40:55 and 40:77 repeat اصبر إن وعد الله حق.
40:77 contrasts seeing only some of what is promised with dying before it and then returning to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated patience-promise-truth formula, partial visibility, death, return, and a split branch of preparation; I infer that readiness and validity precede manifestation. The live alternative is that the non-dominant preparation branch is associative and the context only confirms an ordinary future promise.

changed_reading.before: The promised gardens are a future benefit guaranteed by speech.
changed_reading.after: The gardens are a prepared, fixed destination whose truth already holds through delay, partial visibility, death, and eventual return.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The move is surprising because رحمة in 40:7 and 40:9 ordinarily names mercy, not genealogy. It remains anchored because the packet's kinship branch immediately surrounds a focus ayah that enumerates fathers, spouses, and descendants. Downstream prose should present this as a branch resonance that gives mercy a relational shape, not as a lexical replacement of mercy with womb or kinship.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ومن صلح من آبائهم وأزواجهم وذرياتهم

activation_trace.role: Fatherhood and nurture supply one vertical strand through which surrounding mercy becomes relationally concrete.
Joined counterparts supply the lateral strand of the kin network.
Dispersed small descendants supply the downward strand gathered by mercy.
The رحم and kinship branch lets encompassing mercy take concrete form as restored relation.
The repeated mercy root closes the family petition with the same kin-bearing resonance.

changed_reading.before: Family reunion is one extra benefit bestowed by divine mercy.
changed_reading.after: The repaired, multi-generational relation can itself be carried as a concrete shape taken by the encompassing mercy invoked around the focus.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The model is surprising because it connects a concealed confession under Pharaoh to the semantic concealment and shield branches of جنة. It remains anchored in the focus's garden root and in the explicit concealment-then-protection sequence of 40:28 and 40:45. Downstream prose should qualify it as a spatial-affective transition, not claim that garden literally means secret faith in this ayah.

activation_trace.role: Concealment from perception supplies the garden's latent enclosure image.
A protective shield turns enclosure into durable safety rather than mere invisibility.
The believer's active hiding of faith supplies a precarious human-made concealment.
Divine deflection of harm converts precarious concealment into effective protection.

changed_reading.before: Garden entry moves believers into a visible place of reward.
changed_reading.after: Garden entry can also image transfer from fragile self-concealment amid a hostile house into a divinely made enclosure that protects without requiring fear.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is the most form-distant activation because it uses the packet's non-dominant ع و م mapping for وعد, with branches of swimming and the year. It remains packet-resolvable and is sharpened by the patience, death, and return frame around the repeated promise. Downstream prose must label it as an exploratory image of temporal carriage, never as the lexical meaning or preferred derivation of وعدتهم.

activation_trace.role: Swimming or moving through a medium supplies the exploratory image of a promise carrying its recipients toward arrival.
The yearly cycle supplies the temporal medium through which fulfillment may remain unseen yet active.
The promise joined to patience activates duration rather than immediate arrival.
A promise spanning partial sight, death, and return activates passage across an unseen medium.

changed_reading.before: The promise is a statement about a destination that will later be reached.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the promise itself becomes a mode of carriage across deferred time, holding the promised destination continuous through death until arrival.

strongest_changes: 40:7-9 turns garden admission into the constructive middle of a sequence of forgiveness, protection, repaired relation, and final rescue.
40:28 and 40:45-46 make من صلح a household-redrawing criterion: an individual can be released from a corrupt corporate house while righteous relations are reassembled.
40:39-40 and 40:64 turn the gardens into a stable, provisioned habitat and clarify each reunited relative as a believing doer of صالح.
40:11, 40:46, 40:60, and 40:76 make دخول a terminal destination assignment by opposing garden ingress to failed egress and abiding entry into hell.
40:55 and 40:77 strengthen the promise as true and prepared before it becomes visible.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah repetition made the focus's ingress, garden, صلاح, family list, promise, and closing names operate as one mechanism of just routing and relational re-housing. The split وعد inventory also preserved exploratory preparation and time-crossing images that a dominant-root reading would lose.
remaining_uncertainties: 40:40 strongly supports individual qualification, but the focus may still imply an additional family uplift beyond that minimum rule.
The shelter, kinship-mercy, and concealed-faith links are branch resonances rather than secure lexical specifications.
The preparation and especially the ع و م time-crossing readings depend on non-dominant packet mappings and should remain explicitly exploratory.
